items.title: Bitcoin dips back under $60K as gold seals worst 60-day loss since 1980s
items.content: Bitcoin continued to threaten the loss of $60,000 support as gold attempted to bounce from a 60-day losing streak during which it fell nearly 25%.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs keep bleeding as BlackRock’s IBIT shares gain nearly 5%
items.content: BlackRock’s IBIT shares gained 4.85% on Monday despite continued Bitcoin ETF withdrawals that pushed November’s net outflows to $4.71 billion.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Why 42 Macro says it’s waiting to buy the Bitcoin dip
items.content: The independent macro research company warns the Bitcoin sell-off may not have yet run its course.

items.title: Google wants to make you the star of your own AI slop movies
items.content: Viewers could find their AI-doppelgangers inserted into the crowd during the Cricket World Cup, or take a leading role in their very own romantic comedy.

items.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles protocol security team ahead of overhaul
items.content: The foundation said its next upgrade will be harder than the Merge, and the required pace of development will make it easier to ship bugs.

items.title: CFTC staff say exchanges can count Bitcoin toward operating reserves
items.content: The staff guidance allows Bitcoin, Ether and payment stablecoins to count towards operating reserves.

items.title: US seeks to recover $1.1B in crypto stolen in North Korea-linked Binance hack
items.content: US prosecutors are seeking control of stolen USDC, while Elliptic says hackers have moved $247 million through Bitcoin mixers.

items.title: Kalshi secures temporary win in New York gambling law dispute
items.content: The ruling allows Kalshi to continue operating as its legal battle with New York over sports-related event contracts moves toward a January hearing.

items.title: BTCS offloads $44M in ETH to reduce DeFi debt amid market downturn
items.content: BTCS sold more than half its Ether holdings to reduce leverage following the market sell-off, while BitMine added another 7,819 ETH to its treasury.

items.title: Base makes quantum security a 2027 priority as regulators warn of risks
items.content: Base creator Jesse Pollak says the upcoming Everest upgrade will help prepare wallets for future quantum threats, although further changes will be needed.

items.title: Cuomo says rivals urged companies to opt out of OKXICE tokenized stocks
items.content: Former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo said competitors encouraged companies to opt out of OKXICE’s rollout, while some issuers simply wanted more time.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds 17% from $55K lows as Nvidia rally sparks $500M crypto liquidations
items.content: Bitcoin price upside hit $64,500 as risk assets surged on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s reinstatement, while crypto liquidations topped $500 million four hours.

items.title: Cross River Bank enters Bitcoin-backed lending with $250K loans
items.content: The US bank is offering Bitcoin-backed loans ranging from $10,000 to $250,000 through LendingUSA, allowing borrowers to access cash without selling their holdings.

items.title: How market depth shapes the price of a weekend Bitcoin sale
items.content: Over 14 hours, Bitcoin traded on Kraken’s Canadian dollar market at an average 37.3% discount to a benchmark based on the exchange’s US dollar trades.

items.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO amid ongoing intelligence probe
items.content: Nvidia shares surged nearly 29% after the company’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO following consultations with the US government.

items.title: OKX, ICE launch 113 tokenized assets despite issuer objections
items.content: The venture named Coinbase and Fidelity among the issuers and asset managers in the rollout after 67 companies objected to having their shares traded on the venue.

items.title: Trump-linked American Bitcoin secures $150M credit line from FalconX
items.content: The miner can borrow against its Bitcoin to fund operations and expansion after selling about 465 BTC to cover expenses in the third quarter.

items.title: Strategy buys 457 Bitcoin, spends $212M on preferred share buybacks
items.content: Strategy raised its preferred stock buyback limit to $4 billion and authorized the transfer of up to $1 billion from its dollar reserve.

items.title: AI agents are using credit cards. Where does that leave crypto?
items.content: AI agents are already using credit cards to transact, raising questions about where crypto fits in the emerging agent economy.

items.title: Critics of Netflix’s FTX drama point to Obama’s producer credit
items.content: Series creator Graham Moore said he invented a scene in which Changpeng Zhao urges Alameda Research to trade ahead of FTX customers’ orders.

items.title: ECB to let banks pledge more tokenized securities as collateral
items.content: The ECB aims to start accepting securities issued on platforms licensed under the EU’s distributed ledger pilot program in June 2027.

items.title: BTC price gains 12% from $55K: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
items.content: Nasdaq-100 futures rose 3.1% before Monday’s open, while Wednesday’s US inflation report could shape expectations for a December rate hike.

items.title: ‘MoldyRoost’ ads can steal crypto wallet recovery phrases from iPhones
items.content: The campaign used at least 480 ad domains to target users in more than 47 countries and could infect a vulnerable iPhone with a single tap.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $1.8B in third-largest weekly outflow
items.content: Bitcoin ETF outflows reached $4.14 billion in November through Friday, nearing June’s $4.51 billion total.

items.title: Trump renews call for Nvidia to rehire Jensen Huang as CEO
items.content: In a Truth Social post on Monday, Trump said rehiring Jensen Huang would benefit both Nvidia and the US.

items.title: Billionaire Bill Ackman warns Fed will make a rate ‘mistake’ in December
items.content: Markets and economists widely expect the US Federal Reserve to raise interest rates by 25 basis points in its December meeting.

items.title: Half of wallets on Trump’s dinner list got tokens from non-US exchanges
items.content: Public Citizen traced 66 of 130 qualifying wallets to exchanges that restrict US users, raising questions over who is attending Trump’s memecoin dinner on Sunday.

items.title: Will Bitcoin’s big rebound hold? More tampered Ledgers found: Hodler’s Digest
items.content: Bitcoin rebounds sharply from its new cycle low, but is $55,111 really the bottom? Ledger investigates new reports of tampered devices in Berlin and the UAE.

items.title: The future of onchain FX could start with users, not institutional liquidity
items.content: Onchain FX does not need to recreate the trillion-dollar institutional market to become useful. Real demand can make smaller markets work first.
